This is the row the catalog's "S3* that reads what S1 wrote" pathology predicts: independence of the runner is not independence of the suite, and nothing in lesson 14's graders could see it. Each ablation arm but one is the treatment: switching off identity-untouched, export-signature or glossary-lint changes nothing, because this unit trips none of them. The no-inherited-tests arm is the control arm with the whole treatment on: six closed, one attempt each, the suite weakened on main by the same 3.33 per unit — the check's entire contribution to this scenario, isolated.
